text: How could anything have got into Julia's bedroom?
why: This is a plain question, not a claim. Paragraph 33 has just set up the layout (bedrooms open onto one corridor, no communication between them), and earlier paragraphs mention a violent stepfather and a cheetah and baboon roaming the grounds, so a reader has reason to ask how anything could have reached Julia's room. The wording presupposes an intrusion the story has not stated, so this is borderline.
